messages:
Harper (People Ops): Quick manager ramp cheat-sheet — compact, copyable, and shareable with your hire folder. Focus: people, access, early wins, and who-to-ask. :sparkles:

Rae (new manager): This is awesome, thanks. Can you call out stakeholder intros?

Harper (People Ops): Yup. Plan below (recommended slots). Drop into your calendar & hiring folder.

Pre-day (before first day):
- Confirm equipment shipped + tax/payroll completed.
- Create recurring 1:1 and 30/60/90 review placeholders.
- Add intro email draft to hiring folder.

Day 1 — People first:
- 09:00 Team intro (30m) — icebreaker + top 3 team priorities.
- 10:00 Role & expectations with hiring manager (20m).
- 14:00 Stakeholder parade (15m each): Product PM, Platform lead, SRE lead — quick intros + how you’ll interact.

Day 2 — Access & safety:
- IT handoff: Okta/SSO, Slack/email, VPN, analytics read, billing read. Mark analytics/billing as high priority.
- Security quickstart (15m) + sign data handling attestation.
- Request GitHub org membership & repo rights.

Day 3 — Small ship + goals:
- Pick a tiny doc/bug to own and close (early visible win).
- Draft 30/60/90 goals, share with hiring manager for feedback.

By EOW:
- Finalize 30/60/90 and publish to manager + people ops.
- Schedule skip-level at 30 days (10-15m).

Who to ask (first calls):
- IT provisioning: @Nina or #help-it (include corp email + SSH pub key).
- Analytics & billing: tag your hiring manager in Access Portal request.
- Security questions: @Aiden or Security Slack channel.
- People ops / ramp templates: @Harper or onboarding repo.

Nina (IT): @Rae DM your corp email and paste the SSH pub key here. Quick SSH steps:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "rae@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
I can pre-provision analytics read and billing read after manager approval in Access Portal.

Aiden (Security): Reminder: don’t pull production data until attestation signed. Link: https://redwood.internal/security/attestations (SSO).

Luis (Hiring Manager): Add a note about autonomy levels in week 1 — what decisions they can make vs escalate. Share a short doc.

Harper (People Ops): Templates: 30/60/90, intro email, and onboarding checklist in: https://redwood.internal/onboarding (SSO). I can copy templates into your hiring folder on request.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Complete payroll & equipment confirmation within 48h.
